GENERALIZED 2026-08-12: CollectionClusterType defines TWO things per type - (1) which CollectionTypes are eligible (for City Guide: Restaurants, Shopping, Events) and (2) which FIELD is used to match Collections to a cluster instance (for City Guide: region_id). A CollectionCluster instance stores the actual value for that field (e.g. Mumbai's region_id). Rendering a cluster page = query Collections WHERE collection_type_id IN (allowed types) AND [match field] = [cluster's value] - fully derived, not curated. DIFFERENT cluster types can use DIFFERENT match fields with no collision risk: City Guide filters by region_id, while a company-based cluster (likely 'Affiliation', currently in the Deferred - Backup tab) would filter by company_id instead - since they key off different fields, a Collection's City Guide membership and its Affiliation membership are fully independent. No v1 source table needed for City Guide; CollectionClusterType's allowed-types + match-field config is new v2-only admin config, not migrated data. Revisit this same question when Affiliation is picked back up from Deferred - Backup.
